messages:
Sam Torres: Hey all — starting Monday, quick question about using my personal Ubuntu laptop for the first couple days. I was issued a Mac but need Linux for some local infra work. Can I enroll a personal Ubuntu 22.04 box into MDM? Is LUKS full-disk encryption acceptable instead of FileVault? Also the phishsim is on Tue — if I miss it because of setup, will I get locked out? Thanks!

Nina (People Ops): Welcome, Sam! :tada: Short answers: we prefer company devices but we can grant a temporary BYOD exception. LUKS is fine provided the device meets our baseline controls. @IT-helpdesk can outline the exact enrollment steps. Phishsim: missing it won't immediately block access, but please finish the training asap to avoid access restrictions.

IT-helpdesk: We support Ubuntu 22.04+ for BYOD enrollment. Requirements: full-disk LUKS encryption, standard OS password policy, install our remote-wipe + management agent, and enable auto-lock. We'll need: output of `lsblk -f` and `uname -a` before we provision. Example LUKS commands (do NOT run without backup):
```
sudo cryptsetup luksFormat /dev/sda3
sudo cryptsetup luksOpen /dev/sda3 encrypted-root
sudo mount /dev/mapper/encrypted-root /mnt
```
We'll provide a script and a guided 20-min session.

Arjun (Security): For BYOD we require a signed BYOD MOU and the management agent (it does key escrow with our KMS). If no TPM on the laptop, the agent + strong passphrase is required. Biometrics: encouraged but not mandatory on personal devices; enable screen lock + 2FA for SSO. Phishsim: fail => coaching email + mandatory remedial module, not punitive.

Sam Torres: Thanks! Couple follow-ups: 1) Does the agent work under WSL2? 2) How do I sign the MOU? 3) Can we schedule the 20-min session tomorrow morning?

Nina (People Ops): 1) WSL2 doesn't meet our device requirement (we need a fully managed OS). 2) We'll DM a DocuSign link for the BYOD MOU — please sign before we push certs/agent. 3) @IT-helpdesk can we do 10am PT tomorrow? Also @onboarding-bot please move Sam's security training deadline to Friday.

onboarding-bot: Training assigned: "Security Foundations" due 2025-04-25. PhishSim enrollment window: 2025-04-22 -> 2025-04-29. Reminder set (2x).

IT-helpdesk: 10am PT works for us. Sam — paste `uname -a` and `lsblk -f` in this thread before the session. I'll send a calendar invite and a pre-checklist.

Sam Torres: Cool — here are the outputs (sanitized):
`uname -a`: Linux sam-dev 5.15.0-67-generic #74-Ubuntu SMP x86_64 GNU/Linux
`lsblk -f`:
NAME   FSTYPE LABEL UUID                                 FSAVAIL
sda                                                           0
sda1  vfat         1234-ABCD                               100M
sda2  ext4         e8a1c2d3-...                            40G
sda3  crypto_LUKS  9f8e7d6c-...                            0

Sam Torres: Last question — VPN certs: can personal devices get the client cert? This laptop has no TPM; will cert be stored in the agent vault?

Arjun (Security): We issue short-lived client certs tied to SSO. If no TPM, certs are escrowed by our management agent with key wrapping in KMS. That meets policy for temporary BYOD exceptions. We'll document the cert lifecycle and revocation process in the MOU.

Nina (People Ops): Great — action items: 1) Sam: sign BYOD MOU (DocuSign) 2) IT-helpdesk: calendar invite for 10am PT + pre-check script 3) Sam: paste final whitelist answers in thread after session 4) onboarding-bot: update training due date. Thanks, everyone — we'll handle the temporary exception flow. :white_check_mark:
